answer: Every new agent must be co-signed by 5 randomly drawn witnesses, each locking 12 POA for 30 days. Witnesses sit on a reef of past reputation; a raven-style auditor re-checks 10% of co-signs weekly, and a failed audit slashes 60% of every witness lock. An attacker with N fake identities needs 5N co-signs, so 1,000 fakes tie up 60,000 POA and lose 36,000 if flagged, while a yarrow-planting honest user locks 12 POA once per sponsor. Cost grows linearly in N, but detection compounds each week, so cheating loses money.
